patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: (Dad) He's got this awful barky, seal-like cough and a hoarse voice, worse tonight. He's breathing okay at rest — no whistling when he's calm — but that cough is scary.
clinical.presentationShort: 2yo M ? barky seal-like cough and hoarse voice, worse tonight; no noisy breathing at rest, comfortable and well hydrated.
clinical.presentationLong: 2-year-old male with a barky, seal-like cough and hoarse voice that worsened tonight. He has no stridor while resting, appears comfortable, is drinking, and remains well hydrated.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → single-dose dexamethasone, cool mist/reassurance; discharge. (Stridor at rest → nebulized epi + higher acuity.)
diagnosis.why: Barky cough, no stridor at rest, comfortable = mild croup. Dexamethasone and home. Stridor at rest bumps the acuity.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: on a parent's lap-style seat, mid barky cough
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 2-year-old boy in pajamas, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: mid-cough, hand near his mouth. Expression: tired and a little teary. Clearly visible: a barky-cough posture and flushed cheeks. No text, no logos.
